name: Saragossa Terra
origin: Town held by Marsilion, eventually taken by the French.

name: Roncevaux Terra
origin: Pass where Roland and his forces were ambushed by the Saracens.

name: Toledo Montes
origin: Spanish town known for blacksmiths’ work; the shield of the Saracen knight Malquiant was made there.

name: Abisme
origin: A Saracen lord, killed by Archbishop Turpin.

name: Carcassone Montes
origin: Town in southern France sacked by Roland.

name: Turgis
origin: A Saracen baron; count of Tortelosa; killed by Oliver in the first battle.

name: Engelier
origin: One of Twelve Peers, the Gascon of Bordeaux; the most valiant knight, killed by Climborin in the first battle.

name: Gerin
origin: One of the Twelve Peers; kills Malprimis; killed by Grandoyne.

name: Falsaron
origin: Brother of King Marsilion; killed by Oliver.

name: Malprimis
origin: A Saracen lord from Brigale; killed by Gerin in the first battle.

name: Tortelosa Montes
origin: Spanish town ruled by Count Turgis.

name: Naimon
origin: King Charles’ wisest counselor.

name: Ganelon
origin: French count; stepfather of Roland; brother-in-law of Roland’s uncle Charlemagne; betrays Roland and the French rear guard to Marsilion.

name: Bramimond
origin: Queen of Saragossa, wife of Marsilion.

name: Tibbald
origin: Tibbald of Reims; French baron; guarded French dead at Roncevaux.

name: Roland
origin: Charlemagne's nephew; led rear guard of French forces; hero in song of Roland.

name: Marsilion
origin: Saracen king of Spain; Roland wounds him and he died of wound later.

name: Astor
origin: A French baron; ruled over Valence on Rhone.

name: Malun
origin: A Saracen lord; killed by Oliver.

name: Milon
origin: Guarded French dead while Charlemagne pursued Saracen forces.

name: Oliver
origin: Roland's friend; mortally wounded by Marganice.

name: Thierry
origin: French knight; Duke of Argonne; brother of Godefroy, Charlemagne’s standard bearer. At Ganelon's trial, Thierry alone insists on Ganelon's guilt.

name: Jurfaleu
origin: Son of Marsilion, Saracen king of Spain.

name: Ivon
origin: Frankish baron, one of the Twelve Peers.

name: Ogier
origin: Dane who led 3rd column in Charlemagne's army against Baligant's forces.

name: Hamon
origin: Joint Commander of Charlemagne's Eighth Division.

name: Charlemagne
origin: Emperor of France and Germanic nations; his forces fought the Saracens in Spain.

name: Rabel
origin: A French baron; takes Roland’s place at vanguard of Charlemagne’s forces; leads first column.

name: Turpin
origin: Archbishop of Rheims in Song of Roland.

name: Othon
origin: One of twelve peers; guarded French dead while Charlemagne pursued Saracen forces; sixth column leader.

name: Cordova Mons
origin: Town in Spain taken by Charlemagne.

name: Berenger
origin: One of twelve peers; killed Estramarin; killed by Grandoyne.

name: Clarin
origin: Saracen lord and emissary to Charles.

name: Pinabel
origin: Pinabel of Sorence, a French baron, Ganelon's kinsmen and skilled speaker. Large and powerful, he agrees to fight Thierry to settle the issue of Ganelon's guilt and he lost the judicial combat.

name: Geboin
origin: Guarded French dead; became leader of Charlemagne's 2nd column.

name: Basbrun
origin: Charlemagne’s officer who hung Ganelon’s 30 relatives.

name: Basan
origin: French baron; Murdered while serving as Ambassador of Marsilon.

name: Margaris
origin: Saracen lord from Seville; volunteered to fight at Roncevaux Pass.

name: Corsablis
origin: Saracen lord; volunteered to fight at Roncevaux Pass; killed Archbishop Turpin in the first battle.

name: Seville Mons
origin: Margaris comes from here.

name: Baligant
origin: Emir of Babylon; Marsilion enlisted his help against Charlemagne.

name: Gayne Mons
origin: Spanish town whose walls Roland had shattered.

name: Grandoyne
origin: Son of Cappadocian King Capuel; killed Gerin, Gerier, Berenger, Guy St. Antoine, Duke Astorge; killed by Roland.

name: Johun
origin: Johun of Outremer; Saracen lord and emissary to Charles.

name: Godefroy
origin: Standard bearer of Charlemagne; brother of Tierri, Charlemagne's defender against Pinabel.

name: Matthay
origin: Saracen lord and emissary to Charles.

name: Timozel
origin: A Saracen lord; killed by Gerin and Gerier in the first battle.

name: Adelroth
origin: Marsilion’s nephew, killed by Roland in the first battle.

name: Besgun
origin: Chief cook for Charlemagne's army; he guarded Ganelon after Ganelon's treachery was discovered.

name: Valterne Mons
origin: Escremiz comes from this Spanish town.

name: Climborin
origin: Saracen lord who gave his helmet to Ganelon; killed by Oliver.

name: Dapamort
origin: A Saracen king from Lycia; leader in Baligant’s army.

name: Nevelon
origin: Shares command of Charlemagne’s sixth division; leader of part of the 5th column.

name: Valdebron
origin: Saracen lord, gave his sword to Ganelon.

name: Anseis
origin: One of the Twelve Peers; kills Turgis; killed by Malquiant.

name: Bevon
origin: A French baron; killed by Marsilion.

name: Garlon
origin: Saracen lord and emissary to Charles.

name: Sorence  Mons
origin: Castle of Pinabel.

name: Haltile Mons
origin: Place in Spain near which Basan and Basilie were murdered by Marsilion.

name: Lorant
origin: French commander of one of first divisions against Baligant; killed by Baligant.

name: Almeric
origin: One of 12 peers, killed by Marsilion.

name: Eudropin
origin: Saracen lord and emissary to Charles.

name: Acelin
origin: Aceline of Gascony, one of the Twelve Peers, the council of King Charles.

name: Samson
origin: French baron, Duke of Burgundy; one of the Twelve Peers; killed by Valdebron.

name: Rugis
origin: Saracen lord, one of the Saracen Twelve Peers.

name: Priamon
origin: Saracen lord and emissary to Charles.

name: Torleu
origin: Leader in Baligant’s army; king of Persia; killed by Rabel.

name: Basile
origin: French baron; murdered near Haltile with his brother Basan while serving as ambassador to Marsilion.

name: Escremiz
origin: Escremiz of Valterne; volunteered to fight at Roncevaux Pass; killed by Engelier in the first battle.

name: Cassini Regio
origin: Italian-French astronomer who discovered Iapetus in 1671, Rhea in 1672, Tethys and Dione in 1684 (1625-1712).
